name: @sand/compaction
description: Compacts a conversation into a summary when its context fills up, and reports context usage

sand.label: Compaction
sand.summary: Summarizes long conversations and agents before their context fills up, and /compact

uses.context: the page cannot measure a thread that has not run yet
uses.server: the page gets no context usage
uses.ui: compaction runs without notices and there is no /compact command
uses.modelSettings: context limits use the default model
uses.sessions: the page cannot ask for the context usage of a thread
